notes.title: Barbarossa is going to be at Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
We were invited to Steam Next Fest to introduce our game Barbarossa to the Steam Community!

On October 9th, you can play our demo and have a first look into the world and gameplay of Barbarossa after Next Fest goes live. 

In the demo you will be able to experience:


Roam around a limited part of the open-world.
Experience the mechanics of sailing and fighting with your ship.
Have a glimpse into our item and item upgrade system.
Meet and battle different class of enemies.
Quests to teach you and get you into the game.
[spoiler]Finally, a bossfight to test your skills![/spoiler]


We would be glad if you try the demo and share your experience with us. Your ideas are valuable to us for making Barbarossa a better game.

We invite you to follow us and add Barbarossa to your Wishlist so that you can have the chance to participate in closed playtests and provide us with your feedback!
